other side: crate moves onto the lane (both conveyors at 0.2 m/s)

other side: station: ST_TRANSFER_DONE = 1 when the crate is fully in zone 1

AGV / station action: station raises the end stop, resets ST_READY_RECV; AGV resets its signals and leaves
other side: job closed in fmsctl (crate id at the lane)
station: crate at the lane end (zone 1), no fault
station lowers the end stop, ST_READY_SEND = 1, lane rollers outwards

AGV / station action: station raises the stop, stops the rollers; AGV leaves
Rollers of BOTH sides run only while AGV_PRESENT = 1 and ST_FAULT = 0 (interlock in both PLCs).
A timeout in any step: both sides stop their rollers, the station raises nothing while a crate is over the gap, the job goes to 'transfer error' -> operator.
Loss of AGV_PRESENT during a transfer = immediate stop of both conveyors (the crate stays on the gap; recovery by the operator in manual mode).
The signals are NOT safety functions: people are protected by the light curtain with muting (F4.5 / F8).
